Aries and Aquarius compatibility

How Aries (Mesh) and Aquarius (Kumbh) are traditionally said to get on, and the reasons behind it.

At a glance

Elements
Fire and Air
Modes
Cardinal (chara) and Fixed (sthira)
Ruling planets
Mars and Saturn
Place in the zodiac
3/11 from each other
Graha Maitri (Guna Milan)
0.5 of 5 points
Bhakoot (Guna Milan)
7 of 7 points
Sign-level view

Aries horoscope · Aquarius horoscope

The elements: Fire and Air

Aries is Fire and Aquarius is Air, a pairing the tradition counts as complementary: air feeds fire. Aquarius brings ideas and perspective, Aries brings drive, and together they tend to keep each other moving.

Temperament

Aries is a cardinal sign that starts things, Aquarius a fixed sign that sees them through. The tradition sees a natural division of work in that, as long as Aries does not push for change faster than Aquarius is willing to move.

The ruling planets

Aries is ruled by Mars and Aquarius by Saturn. In the natural friendship of the planets, Mars counts Saturn as neutral, and Saturn counts Mars as an enemy. That gives this pair 0.5 of 5 points in Graha Maitri. Neutral on one side and hostile on the other scores low in this koota, and the tradition advises patience while trust builds.

Their place in the zodiac

Counted from Aries, Aquarius is the eleventh sign; counted from Aquarius, Aries is the third. In Bhakoot this is a 3/11 placement. It scores the full 7 points: the tradition sees the two signs as supporting each other's wellbeing and prosperity.

What each brings

Aries is traditionally said to bring energy, courage, honesty and the will to make things happen to a relationship, and to need room to lead, quick decisions and a partner who does not hold them back. Aquarius is said to bring friendship, originality and an open mind, and to need independence and a real meeting of minds. The pair does well when each gives what the other needs, rather than what they would want themselves.

What signs can and cannot tell you

Everything on this page is the traditional sign-level view. In Guna Milan, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot are read from the two Moon signs (rashi), which need birth times, and they are only two of the eight kootas: the others come from the nakshatras. Two people of the same pair of signs can have very different charts, so a real match is judged from both full birth charts.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Are Aries and Aquarius compatible?

At the level of signs the traditional reading is: mixed. Their Guna Milan points from the two sign-based kootas are 0.5 of 5 for Graha Maitri and 7 of 7 for Bhakoot. Signs are only a starting point; a full kundli matching of both birth charts is what decides.

Should I use my sun sign or my Moon sign here?

Guna Milan uses the Moon sign (rashi), which needs your birth time. The element and temperament notes are often read for the sun sign too, but the Graha Maitri and Bhakoot points only apply to the Moon signs.

Does it matter which partner is Aries and which is Aquarius?

Not for anything on this page: elements, temperament, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot read the same both ways. Some other kootas of Guna Milan, such as Varna and Vashya, do look at who is the bride and who is the groom.
